description: This file contains Vulkan tensor utility functions for formatting tensors, creating staging tensors, copying data between buffers and tensors, packing tensors, and broadcasting utilities within the ATen native Vulkan backend.

methods.name: nchw_to_nc4hw
methods.description: Formats an input tensor from NCHW layout to NC4HW layout for GPU texture copying.

methods.name: create_staging_tensor
methods.description: Creates a staging tensor in NC4HW format for texture data transfer.

methods.name: nc4hw_to_nchw
methods.description: Reformats a tensor from NC4HW back to NCHW layout after copying from GPU.

methods.name: copy_buffer_to_vtensor
methods.description: Copies data from a Vulkan buffer to a vTensor.

methods.name: copy_buffer_to_buffer
methods.description: Copies data between two Vulkan buffers.

methods.name: copy_vtensor_to_buffer
methods.description: Copies data from a vTensor to a Vulkan buffer.

methods.name: pack_buffer_to_vtensor
methods.description: Packs a Vulkan buffer into a vTensor, either as buffer or image.

methods.name: pack_staging_to_vtensor
methods.description: Packs staging buffer data into a vTensor.

methods.name: pack_vtensor_to_staging
methods.description: Packs a vTensor into staging buffer, returns success status.

methods.name: is_broadcastable
methods.description: Checks if two tensors are broadcastable under Vulkan constraints.

methods.name: broadcast_size
methods.description: Calculates broadcasted shape from two tensors.

methods.name: extract_texel
methods.description: Extracts a texel value from a Vulkan tensor at a given position.
